title: Refresh access tokens transparently
description: Access tokens expire after 15 minutes and users were getting bounced to login. `getAccessToken` now refreshes when the token is close to expiry. Note: the auth server rotates refresh tokens (each one is single-use; reusing one revokes the session).

expected_issues.description: Concurrent callers (a page firing several API requests at once) all see an expired token and each start their own refresh with the same single-use refresh token; the second use is treated as reuse and revokes the session, logging the user out. Share one in-flight refresh promise across callers.
